desc:
An AK-47 assault rifle having its magazine be taken out and put back in again.

this sound was made by mixing various recordings of me reloading multiple different airsoft weapons i have. i think it actually came out pretty well imho.

crediting me isn't required if you decide to use my sound, but it would be greatly appreciated if you do!
title: AK-47 Assault Rifle being unloaded and reloaded
